records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#1
records.source: Exports use the supplied ``QImage`` or ``QPixmap`` rather than capturing the surrounding widget. PNG preserves the image's pixel dimensions and records the selected resolution as dots-per-metre metadata. PDF embeds the raster image on a page; it does not convert pixels into vector artwork.

PDF bettet das Rasterbild auf einer Seite ein; Pixel werden nicht in Vektorgrafik umgewandelt.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#2
